title: AgentKit Page Spec
description: Declarative page description compiled by @agentkit/render into deterministic, offline, interactive HTML.

actionMap.description: Declarative action bindings, keyed by event name.

oneOf.description: Copy the text content of the target node to the clipboard.

url.description: Relative path (local asset) or an absolute URL with an allowlisted scheme.

oneOf.description: Open an allowlisted URL in a new tab.
Toggle the expanded, open, or active state of the target node.

value.description: Literal value assigned to the state path.

oneOf.description: Set a page state value without an expression.
Advance a carousel, slideshow, or step sequence to the next item.
Move a carousel, slideshow, or step sequence to the previous item.
Select a tab by index or id inside a tabs block.
Expand a disclosure or accordion section.
Collapse a disclosure or accordion section.
Filter a collection by the current search input value.
Download the target node content as a file.

block-page.description: Page root: title, description, locale, and top-level blocks.

block-section.description: Section with an optional heading wrapping child blocks.

block-stack.description: Stack: children flow vertically with a controlled gap.

block-grid.description: Grid: children in N columns that collapse on narrow viewports.

block-split.description: Split: two child groups side by side, stacking when narrow.

block-divider.description: Divider: semantic separator with an optional label.

block-heading.description: Heading: h1–h6 with the author-chosen level.

block-text.description: Text: single paragraph with body, lead, or caption treatment.

block-rich-text.description: RichText: multiple paragraphs from line breaks.

block-quote.description: Quote: blockquote with an optional attribution.

block-code.description: Code: preformatted block with optional language and copy target.

block-kbd.description: Kbd: one or more keys rendered as <kbd> elements.

block-key-value.description: KeyValue: label/value pairs rendered as a description list.

block-card.description: Card: titled container that holds child blocks.

block-alert.description: Alert: notice with tone and title.

block-callout.description: Callout: highlighted aside with tone, title, and body.

block-hero.description: Hero: eyebrow, title, and one-line description.

block-stats.description: Stats: labeled values as a figure list.

block-progress.description: Progress: single bar with an accessible value range.

block-steps.description: Steps: numbered sequence of titled steps.

block-timeline.description: Timeline: ordered entries with a when/title/body shape.

block-list.description: List: bulleted items with optional status badges.

block-card-grid.description: CardGrid: titled cards in a responsive grid.

block-table.description: Table: columns and rows with a real header row.

block-comparison.description: Comparison: two labeled columns of points.

block-risk-matrix.description: RiskMatrix: risks rated by impact and likelihood.

on.description: Optional state binding fired when a tab is selected.
Optional state binding fired when a section toggles.

block-accordion.description: Accordion: disclosure sections that expand and collapse.

on.description: Optional state binding fired when the active slide changes.

block-carousel.description: Carousel: prev/next, keyboard, and swipe across slides.

on.description: Declarative action bindings for this block.

href.description: Relative path (local asset) or an absolute URL with an allowlisted scheme.

on.description: Declarative action bindings for this block.

block-toolbar.description: Toolbar: buttons, badges, and links in one accessible row.

block-chart.description: Chart: bar, line, area, pie, donut, sparkline, or progress from labeled series.

block-diagram-panel.description: DiagramPanel: embeds trusted output from a diagram adapter (ak:diagram when installed).

src.description: Relative path (local asset) or an absolute URL with an allowlisted scheme.

block-image.description: Image: local asset or allowlisted URL with required alt text.

src.description: Relative path (local asset) or an absolute URL with an allowlisted scheme.

block-gallery.description: Gallery: responsive image grid with captions.

src.description: Relative path (local asset) or an absolute URL with an allowlisted scheme.

poster.description: Relative path (local asset) or an absolute URL with an allowlisted scheme.

url.description: Relative path (local asset) or an absolute URL with an allowlisted scheme.

block-video.description: Video: plays local sources; a provider reference becomes a poster plus link; network sources degrade to poster plus link.

src.description: Relative path (local asset) or an absolute URL with an allowlisted scheme.

url.description: Relative path (local asset) or an absolute URL with an allowlisted scheme.

block-audio.description: Audio: plays local sources; a provider reference becomes metadata plus link; network sources degrade to metadata plus link.

on.description: Action bindings; a button without bindings is a diagnostic.

block-button.description: Button: clickable control with declarative action bindings.

href.description: Relative path (local asset) or an absolute URL with an allowlisted scheme.

block-link.description: Link: allowlisted URL with descriptive text.

on.description: Binding fired when the value changes.

block-slider.description: Slider: range input with pointer drag and full keyboard support.

on.description: Filter binding; requires a target collection.

block-search.description: Search: labeled filter input bound to a collection.

on.description: Declarative action bindings for this block.

block-dialog.description: Dialog: native <dialog> with labeled title and close controls.

block-diff-summary.description: DiffSummary: file paths with change status and line counts.
